name: Lebanon Horse-Drawn Carriage Parade and Christmas Festival
when_note: Saturday, December 5, festival 10 AM to 8 PM, carriage parades at 1 PM and 7 PM
paras: The Lebanon Area Chamber of Commerce presents the 37th annual Horse-Drawn Carriage Parade and Christmas Festival in downtown Lebanon on Saturday, December 5, 2026. A daylight parade rolls at 1 PM and a candlelight parade follows at 7 PM, with dozens of decorated horse-drawn carriages along the historic downtown streets.

The Christmas festival and market runs from 10 AM to 8 PM with food trucks, vendors, holiday shopping and pictures with Santa. The city adds that Santa, Mrs. Claus and mini-Highlander cows will be at Bicentennial Park next to the Christmas Market. The festival is free, and parking and a shuttle are free.
tip: Claim a curb spot early for the 1 PM daylight parade, or come back for the 7 PM candlelight parade.
